title: GROUNDING-AGENT-001: add v0.1 trial ledger template
intent: Add the lightweight operational trial ledger for Grounding Agent v0.1 — one table (one row per real use) plus a short summary/decision block — so the trial period can be measured (handoffs checked, stale caught, false positives/negatives, blocked runs, human overrides, time saved) before deciding KEEP/REVISE/RETIRE. This is the measurement instrument for the experiment, not additional agent architecture.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Adds a single documentation file, docs/governance/agents/GROUNDING_AGENT_v0.1_TRIAL_LEDGER.md, containing the trial ledger table and summary/decision block, plus this CBSP21 manifest. No code, schema, route, workflow, or build file is touched.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: No trial ledger exists for Grounding Agent v0.1; the merged spec references a trial period but provides no instrument to record it. This adds that instrument without duplicating the spec and without expanding the tool's scope.

files.intent: Trial ledger template: per-use table + summary/decision block for the v0.1 trial period.

architecture_scan.acknowledgement_notes: Documentation-only trial ledger under docs/governance/agents/. No code, workflow, or _experimental/ paths touched.

no_backend_no_schema: No backend API, route, schema, persistence, workflow, or build change. Adds one documentation file plus this CBSP21 manifest.
